quarterly_data.signal: Customers and order visibility (DART half-year report, as of 2026-06-30): the detailed order book is withheld under customer NDAs, but four customers each above 10% of revenue took KRW 91,958M (customer A), KRW 62,596M (B), KRW 51,576M (C) and KRW 44,253M (D) of H1 2026 revenue, against KRW 80,504M / KRW 27,989M / KRW 23,872M / KRW 28,963M a year earlier - customers B, C and D roughly doubled while A grew modestly, so growth is broadening beyond the largest account. The report names its domestic customers only as 'Company S' and 'Company H' and says overseas customers include 'Company M' plus more than ten others; all sales are direct to device makers with no distributors. Contract liabilities (customer prepayments on tools not yet delivered) rose to KRW 27,590,991 thousand from KRW 20,211,333 thousand at end-2025, and inventories rose to KRW 129,263M from KRW 104,214M with work-in-process more than doubling to KRW 14,407M - a build-ahead consistent with a rising delivery schedule.
quarterly_data.figure: Top-4 customers KRW 91,958M / 62,596M / 51,576M / 44,253M of H1 revenue (vs KRW 80,504M / 27,989M / 23,872M / 28,963M); contract liabilities KRW 27,590,991 thousand (from KRW 20,211,333 thousand); inventories KRW 129,263M (from KRW 104,214M), WIP KRW 14,407M; detailed backlog withheld under NDA
quarterly_data.counterparty: customers disclosed only as Company A/B/C/D and as 'Company S' and 'Company H' domestically and 'Company M' plus 10+ others overseas - not named in the filing

quarterly_data.signal: Production, capacity and input costs (DART half-year report): 149 process tools were built at the Hwaseong Dongtan plant in H1 2026 against 187 in the whole of FY2025 and 191 in FY2024; a utilisation rate is not disclosed because production is strictly build-to-order after a customer purchase order. Average selling price per process tool KRW 1,382M (KRW 1,422M in FY2025, KRW 1,453M in FY2024). Bought-in key parts are plasma generation sources at KRW 42,913M (27.0% of raw-material purchases) and wafer-transfer robots at KRW 12,117M (7.6%), sourced from Korea, the United States and Japan; the combined key-component unit price rose to KRW 68,463 thousand from KRW 62,831 thousand, exposed to the won and to component supply. Capacity was expanded in H1: KRW 20,153,833 thousand was transferred out of construction in progress as a new building was completed, lifting the buildings line to KRW 50,579,667 thousand, and KRW 19,921,568 thousand of construction in progress remains; H1 property, plant and equipment purchases were KRW 8,783,896,836 and Chinese non-current assets jumped to KRW 22,274,676 thousand from KRW 5,946,012 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: 149 tools built in H1 (187 in FY2025, 191 in FY2024); ASP KRW 1,382M per tool; plasma sources KRW 42,913M (27.0%) and robots KRW 12,117M (7.6%) of purchases, key-component price KRW 68,463 thousand vs KRW 62,831 thousand; new building KRW 20,153,833 thousand transferred from CIP; H1 capex KRW 8,783,896,836

quarterly_data.signal: R&D and market position (DART half-year report): H1 R&D spend KRW 15,349M, 4.7% of revenue against 7.8% in FY2025, including KRW 309M of government grants. Product lines are Dry Strip, Dry Cleaning, Wafer Edge Clean, Selective Material Removal, New Hard Mask Strip and Bevel Etch. The live development programme is a low-energy plasma dry-strip tool run with the Korea Institute of Fusion Energy from 2026-01, following an atomic-layer-etch (ALE) tool with real-time process control (2020-07 to 2023-12), an intelligent-semiconductor New Hard Mask Strip tool for metal-bearing mask films (2022-04 to 2024-12) and a high-aspect-ratio contact-hole dry-cleaning tool (2022-09 to 2025-12). PSK Inc. reports a 39% share of the world dry-strip market in 2025 (42% in 2021, 38% in 2022, 40% in 2023 and 2024) on Gartner data, with 306 patents registered and 329 applied.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D KRW 15,349M (4.7% of sales vs 7.8% in FY2025); world dry-strip share 39% in 2025 (42% in 2021); pipeline: low-energy plasma dry strip with Korea Institute of Fusion Energy from 2026-01, ALE, HAR contact-hole dry clean, New Hard Mask Strip; 306 patents registered

quarterly_data.signal: Equipment-market outlook quoted in the half-year report: SEMI (2026.02) puts the world semiconductor equipment market at USD 115.69B in 2025, USD 126.07B in 2026 and USD 135.22B in 2027, with Korea USD 22.37B then 25.43B then 28.35B, North America USD 9.87B then 18.46B then 19.67B, Taiwan USD 25.99B then 24.93B, China USD 43.50B then 41.17B and Japan USD 8.15B then 9.25B. Gartner (2026.03) puts the dry-strip segment, PSK Inc.'s main product, at USD 743M in 2025, USD 862M in 2026 and USD 940M in 2027 before easing to USD 924M in 2028. The report notes front-end tools are about 70% of all equipment spend and that quarterly revenue is lumpy because sales are booked on tool delivery, not on percentage of completion.

quarterly_data.signal: Litigation risk on the localised dry-strip line (DART half-year report): Lam Research Corporation sued PSK Inc. in 2021 at the Seoul Central District Court (case 2021Gahap571611, patent infringement injunction) after PSK localised dry-strip equipment and entered the Korean market that Lam had held; PSK counter-filed invalidation trials against six Lam patents. Three of the six have been finally invalidated and one finally upheld; of the remaining two, one was held partly invalid and partly valid and remanded to the Intellectual Property Trial and Appeal Board, and one was held invalid by the Patent Court and is still pending on remand. The infringement suit runs separately on whichever patents survive and the company states it cannot reasonably predict the outcome.
quarterly_data.figure: Lam Research patent-infringement suit pending since 2021; 3 of 6 Lam patents finally invalidated, 1 upheld, 2 still in dispute
